caption: The drawing is of a card table, depicted in three views: front, side, and top. The table is shown with dimensions annotated in inches. The overall width is 46 inches, the height is 27 1/2 inches, and the depth is 21 inches. The front view shows detailed legs and decorative elements, with a curved section beneath the tabletop indicating the table’s folding or extendable feature. The tabletop's width at the front is 32 5/8 inches, and the curved extension is 26 inches wide. The side view shows how the table top can be extended with a semi-circular leaf. The legs feature decorative inlays or carvings. The top of the drawing features handwritten text identifying the object as a "Card Table" designed and made by Duncan Phyfe, constructed from mahogany with brass ferules for Ginsburg & Levy at 815 Madison Ave. The drawing is executed in dark ink on a light beige background, with precise lines and measurements throughout. There are also some handwritten notes and a signature, “J.F.R.,” at the bottom right corner, along with a blue annotation at the right edge.
title: Pembroke Table
